panel_descriptions.pos_3: A small sharp triangular loop meets a larger curved sector at an oblique central junction.
panel_descriptions.pos_4: A single long, narrow, pointed quadrilateral outline runs diagonally downward to the right.
panel_descriptions.pos_5: A triangular loop is assembled from outlined triangles along one side, outlined circles along another, and a solid oblique segment along the third.
